newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 140-day BBCs at 2.216 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 140-day BBCs at 2.216 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 1.858 billion reais of 140-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight rate of 2.216 percent a month, up from 2.198 percent last week, dealers said.
The Central Bank also sold 2.273 billion reais in 182-day BBCs at an overnight rate of 2.235 percent a month, up from 2.224 percent last week. dealers said. .
The financial result of the auction indicated 131 million reais will be drained from the banking system as four billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
